name: The EARTH SEO Match
summary: Buy any EARTH movie ticket and send the receipt with an SEO order. Eye To Ad Media adds SEO service credit equal to 2 times what you pay for SEO, so the SEO work is triple the investment.

eligibility.qualifying_purchase: Any ticket to the EARTH movie
eligibility.proof: Send the ticket receipt with the SEO order, or email it when ordering

benefit.credit_formula: credit = 2 x amount paid for SEO
benefit.total_seo_work_formula: amount paid + credit = 3 x amount paid
benefit.usable_for: SEO services from Eye To Ad Media only

early_end: Ends early only with notice posted on https://eyetoad.com/match/; credit already earned is not affected
climate_note: 1.5% of EARTH ticket revenue funds carbon removal through Stripe Climate.
how_to_order: Build the order at https://eyetoad.com/match/#order and press 'Send to the eyetoad.com team', or call 1-800-481-8638. No payment is taken on the page; the team confirms scope and sends an invoice.
